title: Trump's EEOC Started Rewriting Civil Rights Around White Grievance
description_short: Trump's EEOC Started Rewriting Civil Rights Around White Grievance
description_medium: NPR reported that Trump-appointed EEOC chair Andrea Lucas shifted the agency’s public emphasis toward DEI and claims of discrimination against white people. Lucas sent Fortune 500 leaders a letter warning that workplace DEI policies could violate federal law if they influenced employment decisions based on protected traits. The EEOC was also investigating Nike’s hiring goals and career-development practices.
description_long: NPR reported that Andrea Lucas, Trump’s appointee to lead the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, was changing the agency’s priorities. In late February 2026, Lucas sent a letter to Fortune 500 company leaders warning that diversity, equity, and inclusion policies could violate federal law if they affected employment decisions based on race, sex, or another protected characteristic. She urged companies to reject “identity politics” and said the EEOC was ready to address discrimination. The agency was also investigating Nike’s hiring goals and career-development practices to determine whether they disadvantaged white people. Lucas said the same rules should apply regardless of who claims discrimination. NPR contrasted this focus with the EEOC’s historic work protecting vulnerable and underserved workers. It also reported that the agency had about 1,740 employees, following hundreds of departures since Trump returned to office. The article documents a shift in emphasis and specific agency activity; it does not establish that the Nike investigation found unlawful discrimination or that the agency stopped handling other discrimination claims.

title: Memecoin Dinner Announcement Pumps $TRUMP 60%; Foreigners Buy White House Access
description_short: Memecoin Dinner Announcement Pumps $TRUMP 60%; Foreigners Buy White House Access
description_medium: On April 23, 2025, a $TRUMP promotion offered the coin’s 220 largest holders a private dinner with President Trump on May 22; the top 25 were also promised a VIP White House tour. Reuters reported that the announcement was followed by a rise of more than 60% in the coin’s price. The offer linked access to the president with holding a token bearing his name.
description_long: On April 23, 2025, a website promoting the $TRUMP coin announced that its 220 largest holders would receive invitations to a private dinner with President Trump at his golf club on May 22. The 25 top holders were also offered a VIP White House tour. Reuters reported that the coin rose more than 60% within hours of the announcement. The promotion linked access to the president with holding a speculative token bearing his name, drawing criticism that it blurred public access and private financial promotion. The rapid price increase does not show that Trump or the issuer sold tokens or received an equivalent cash gain. At the later dinner, roughly 220 investors attended, including Justin Sun, who was facing SEC fraud allegations, and guests from China, Singapore, and South Korea. Those attendance details concern the May event, not the April offer. No official policy decision made at the dinner is established.

title: Laura Loomer Triggers Mass Purge of National Security Council Staff
description_short: Laura Loomer Triggers Mass Purge of National Security Council Staff
description_medium: In April 2025, reports said that after Laura Loomer met Trump in the Oval Office and raised loyalty concerns about National Security Council staff, the administration dismissed at least 15 officials. The first group included senior staff working on intelligence, technology, and legislative affairs. The reported firings mark a personnel change; Loomer’s role in the decision and the details of later dismissals require separate support.
description_long: In early April 2025, far-right activist and conspiracy theorist Laura Loomer visited the Oval Office and presented President Trump with a dossier accusing National Security Council staff of disloyalty to MAGA. Trump, furious, directed National Security Adviser Mike Waltz to fire them on the spot. At least 15 NSC officials were dismissed in the first wave—including senior directors overseeing intelligence, technology, and legislative affairs. By April 24, Reuters confirmed at least 20 firings total, leaving sections overseeing Latin America, legislative affairs, and international organizations largely unstaffed. Loomer, who has promoted QAnon-adjacent theories, openly took credit on social media. On May 23, 2025, a second mass termination swept the NSC as Secretary of State Marco Rubio (by then interim National Security Adviser) fired dozens more staff covering nearly every major geopolitical issue, from Ukraine to Kashmir. The administration aimed to shrink the NSC to just a few dozen people. Former national security officials described the gutting as catastrophic for institutional knowledge and America's ability to coordinate complex foreign policy responses.

title: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Third Bankruptcy Filing
description_short: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Third Bankruptcy Filing
description_medium: A March 9, 1992 UPI report described bankruptcy filings involving Trump’s Castle and Plaza, two Atlantic City casino properties. The proceedings followed the Taj Mahal’s earlier restructuring but concern different companies and an earlier date. They do not establish the separate claim that Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts filed for bankruptcy in 1993.

preserved_fields.title: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Third Bankruptcy Filing
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Third Bankruptcy Filing

notes: Needs context: the linked UPI report is dated March 9, 1992 and concerns Trump’s Castle and Plaza, not a 1993 filing by Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts. It does not substantiate the title’s claim that this was Trump’s third bankruptcy. Proposed correction: identify the company and court filing date from a source documenting the 1993 restructuring before retaining the title.

title: U.S. Officially Enters Recession After GDP Contracts in Q2
description_short: U.S. Officially Enters Recession After GDP Contracts in Q2
description_medium: The U.S. economy officially entered a recession in August 2025 after the GDP contracted sharply in the second quarter. Economists directly attributed the downturn to the chaotic implementation of mass deportations, tariff wars, and the gutting of federal agencies. The economic collapse led to massive job losses and widespread financial panic.
